description: This file defines a Java class 'DummyIdempotencyMiddleware' which implements command middleware to ensure idempotency for commands, particularly handling 'DummyCommand' instances by tracking processed IDs and preventing duplicates.

classes.name: DummyIdempotencyMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that enforces idempotency for commands by tracking processed command IDs and blocking duplicates

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Checks if the command is a DummyCommand, and if so, throws an exception if the command's ID has already been processed, otherwise adds the ID to the processed list

calls: throw new CommandIllegalArgumentException(c, "Duplicate request ID: " + c.getId())
